quest.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 1
quest.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Huh, this doesn't seem right, either... These gift envelopes are really hard to make.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mika, are you making gift envelopes?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! What a coincidence! I wasn't expecting to see you here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you here to celebrate Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no. I came to deliver a letter, and it just so happened to be during Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Klee said she really wanted a Lantern Rite gift envelope, so I thought about buying one to take back.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Imagine my surprise when I found out you have to make them yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I spent a long time trying to make one, but it still feels "off" for some reason. I can't tell where I went wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you know more about Liyue customs than me... Could you give me some advice on how to improve it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think about it for a second...

talks.objective: Complete the Gift Envelope with Mika

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you know more about Liyue customs than me... Could you give me some advice on how to improve it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think about it for a second...

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #Whoa, it's beautiful! So well made, and you did it so fast... You're amazing, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: ...Oh no! I should really get going! I need to report back to the Knights!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: #Thanks for the help, {NICKNAME}! I'm sure Klee will love the envelope.
